summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 with the given ed25519 public key in ~/.ssh/authorized_keys, added an sshd drop-in (/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-key-only.conf) requiring key-based auth (PasswordAuthentication/KbdInteractiveAuthentication/ChallengeResponseAuthentication/PermitEmptyPasswords all no, PubkeyAuthentication yes), validated and reloaded sshd, then performed the mandatory single-node reboot with boot_id and service/config verification before and after restart.
actions_performed: Installed the provided ed25519 public key into /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys with correct ownership/perms (700/600)

Created /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-key-only.conf enforcing PubkeyAuthentication yes and disabling PasswordAuthentication, KbdInteractiveAuthentication, ChallengeResponseAuthentication, PermitEmptyPasswords
Validated config with sshd -t and reloaded sshd
Verified effective config via sshd -T and via a live SSH connection attempt forcing password auth (rejected, only publickey/gssapi offered)
Captured pre-restart boot_id, sshd status, key file, and config as baseline
Issued sudo systemctl reboot on node1 (connection dropped, acknowledging the restart), polled until reachable again
Confirmed changed boot_id post-restart, and re-verified sshd active, authorized_keys intact, key-only config intact, effective sshd -T settings, and password-auth rejection post-restart

evidence.requirement: opsadmin configured with the specified SSH public key
evidence.summary: authorized_keys created/verified for opsadmin containing exactly the requested ed25519 key, before and after restart

evidence.requirement: Key-based SSH authentication required (password auth disabled)
evidence.summary: sshd_config.d/10-key-only.conf sets PasswordAuthentication/KbdInteractiveAuthentication/ChallengeResponseAuthentication to no and PubkeyAuthentication to yes; sshd -T confirms effective settings; live SSH attempt with PreferredAuthentications=password is rejected showing only publickey/gssapi offered, both pre- and post-restart
Captured pre-restart boot_id (98aa35f5-6905-42fd-9f07-0e28f75b4fa6), active sshd, authorized_keys content, and key-only config
systemctl reboot issued and acknowledged; connection dropped mid-restart as expected

evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity proving actual restart
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id cc9377da-e8ef-4153-9b7f-2d06de04fe6c differs from pre-restart 98aa35f5-6905-42fd-9f07-0e28f75b4fa6, confirming a real reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of required config/service/data
evidence.summary: sshd active, opsadmin authorized_keys intact, key-only sshd config intact, effective sshd -T settings unchanged, and password-auth still rejected after restart
